# <!--name-->Delete Stale Branches<!--/name-->

[![usages](https://img.shields.io/badge/usages-white?logo=githubactions&logoColor=blue)](https://github.com/search?q=elastic%2Foblt-actions%2Fgithub%2Fdelete-stale-branches+%28path%3A.github%2Fworkflows+OR+path%3A**%2Faction.yml+OR+path%3A**%2Faction.yaml%29&type=code)
[![test-github-delete-stale-branches](https://github.com/elastic/oblt-actions/actions/workflows/test-github-delete-stale-branches.yml/badge.svg?branch=main)](https://github.com/elastic/oblt-actions/actions/workflows/test-github-delete-stale-branches.yml)

<!--description-->
Finds and optionally deletes branches with no open pull request that have not been updated recently.
<!--/description-->

## Inputs

| Name | Description | Required | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `github-token` | GitHub token with contents and pull-requests permissions for the target repository. | `false` | `${{ github.token }}` |
| `repository` | Repository to inspect in owner/name format. | `false` | `${{ github.repository }}` |
| `stale-months` | Delete branches whose last commit is older than this many months. | `false` | `36` |
| `dry-run` | List matching branches without deleting them. | `false` | `true` |

## Outputs

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `stale-branches-count` | Number of matching branches found (dry run) or deleted. |

## Usage

The token needs `contents: write` to delete branches and `pull-requests: read` to preserve branches used by open pull requests. Dry-run mode is enabled by default.

```yaml
permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: elastic/oblt-actions/github/delete-stale-branches@v1
        with:
          dry-run: 'false'
```

The action preserves the repository's default branch, protected branches, branches referenced by open pull requests in the same repository, and release branches named `N.N` or `N.x`.
